items.title: Align decision-doc audits with automatic escalation policy
items.context: Replace the always-on decision-doc 3x2 rule in the execution plan with a unified audit policy: documentation/decision-doc changes start with ordinary REVIEW, escalate to full 3x2 only when first REVIEW round has at least two countable problems, and can use explicit degraded 3x1 under the same fallback rules.
items.userSees: User sees: The plan now says documentation and decision-doc audit follow normal REVIEW first, then automatic full 3x2 or degraded 3x1 only when the same escalation rules trigger.

happy.desc: The document says documentation and decision-doc audit use the same ordinary REVIEW default as other development work.
The document says documentation and decision-doc audit escalate to 3x2 only when the first REVIEW round records at least two countable problems.

edge.desc: The document states current code may still enforce legacy decision-doc 3x2 until the implementation story updates the gate.
The document says documentation audit can use the same explicit degraded 3x1 fallback when allowed by policy or approval.

adversarial.desc: The document no longer preserves always-on decision-doc 3x2 as the desired target policy.
The document does not claim the automatic document-audit policy is already implemented in runtime code.

verificationEvidence.note: The document purpose and Documentation Audit Unified Rule state that documentation and decision-doc audit use the same default REVIEW path as ordinary development. The assertion command printed: doc policy and English-only checks passed.
The DONE Gate section now defines the target formula as requires3x2 = firstReviewRoundCountableProblems >= 2, and the test matrix says zero or one countable first-round finding does not require 3x2.

The purpose, current-state table, documentation audit rule, and DONE Gate transition note explicitly say current runtime may still enforce legacy direct decision-doc 3x2 until a follow-up implementation story migrates the gate.
The degraded fallback rule and decision-doc tests state that escalated documentation audit may use approved degraded 3x1 only with assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host and without claiming full 3x2.

The old purpose line Always-on: direct decision-doc changes still require 3 quorum rounds x 2 independent PASS hosts is absent. Decision-doc changes with zero countable first-round findings are now expected to require3x2=false under the target policy.

The document labels automatic document-audit behavior as the target policy and repeatedly says current implementation may still be legacy until the implementation story changes the runtime gate; it does not claim runtime implementation is already complete.
